title: BYOB Utrecht Citytour
excerpt: BYOB's tenth anniversary: a one-night city tour of projections across nine pop-up galleries in Utrecht.
description:
Bring Your Own Beamer 2020. For BYOB's tenth anniversary we turned the city of Utrecht into a one-night tour of projections, installations and performances across nine pop-up public galleries, on 26 September 2020. The edition ran as part of NFF interactive, the Dutch Film Festival programme for trans-medial and interactive work, and because of the covid measures the whole thing moved into the public space: an evening walk through the city, from location to location.
> BYOB is a non-hierarchical, open-call format: participants aren't curated but facilitated, choosing where and how to show their work. Made possible by more than 50 participants and over 1,000 visitors, all within the strict COVID-19 regulations of the time.
credits: Organised by Jaco Schilp. Part of NFF interactive at the Nederlands Film Festival, Utrecht, 2020.
